title: Retrieval-evaluation golden queries
description: Validates queries.yaml (parsed to JSON) at a frozen fixture corpus root (Phase A, docs/roadmap.md). Each entry names a query class from the roadmap's query-type table; four classes are admitted by this contract but disabled until their phase ships (see `class`). Whether every `enabled` query has a matching entry in judgements.yaml is the loader's to verify (S2).

id.description: Stable slug identifying this query within the corpus. What a judgements.yaml entry's `queryId` names.

class.description: The query-type table's row this query measures (docs/roadmap.md §5). `historical` (Phase D), `spec-adr-impl` and `code-decision` (Phase C), and `impact` (Phase E) are admitted here so the corpus can carry them ahead of the mechanism that answers them, but a query in one of those four classes validates only with `enabled: false` — see the constraint below.

query.description: The query text. Bounded to 2,000 characters, the same bound `knowledge.search`'s wire contract refuses beyond (`MAX_QUERY_CHARS`, schemas/mcp/knowledge-search-input.schema.json) — a fixture query longer than the wire accepts could never be replayed against a live daemon.

enabled.description: Whether the harness runs this query. Defaults to `true`.

corpora.description: Which corpus indexes this query runs against. Defaults to `["full"]`. An empty list would run against nothing, which is not a query the harness can execute.
